name: Redshift Clouds Object
definition: Generates entire procedural skies. It has a fast mode that renders the cloud deck as a clever background and a fully volumetric mode in which a skyscraper or an aircraft can pierce the cloud layer and be lit by it.
summary: The Redshift Clouds Object generates procedural skies, distinguishing itself by supporting both fast background rendering and fully volumetric modes where geometry pierces the cloud layer.
